title: TanStack Redact — a lighter React runtime
summary: TanStack Redact swaps React's browser runtime at build time and cuts bundles by 20–70% with no app code changes — at the cost of synchronous rendering and compatibility you have to test yourself.

source.title: TanStack Redact brings a lighter React runtime
source.author: Atharva Deosthale

title: TanStack Start vs Next.js (2026) — same app, real benchmarks
summary: The same app built in both frameworks and measured on 2 cores: Start serves 2.9–8.6× more server-rendered requests, ships 20% less JS and builds 3.9× faster — Next.js only wins on prerendered static pages.

source.title: TanStack Start vs Next.js (2026): Same App Benchmarked
source.author: Waseem Anjum
